name: Garawa Nursing Scholarship
summary: Covers the costs of a rural or remote Northern Territory nursing placement for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander QUT students.
key: Awarded to the value of $5,000, spent first on placement travel and accommodation.
who: Identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.
Starting third year of the Bachelor of Nursing (NS42) or final year of the Master of Nursing Entry to Practice (NS89).
Willing to do a primary health care placement in a rural or remote Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander community in the NT.
catches: The terms found were updated in June 2023. Check the current round.
